label: Marry Marian
description: Both paths through this lead to the same place — a widow and an apprentice, made one household.

label: See Astorre's Naples condotta through
description: Astorre's company serves a paid campaign at Naples — once the terms are struck, it runs its own course and comes home in time.

label: Deliver the Milan cannon shipment
description: Buy at Milan, sail it to Naples via Genoa, and be there with enough of it before the deadline lapses.

label: First blood with St Pol
description: The vendetta's opening move. Not a choice that can be avoided, only shaped.

label: Felix's fate
description: A scripted loss, not a choice — position for it, don't expect to prevent it.
